column1: # Guitar Rig 6 (aufx Ni$R -NI-), headless. Reproduce: see the docstring of evidence/scripts/gr6eq.py (setup: auhost state, ngrc_xml.py; gr6state.py and ngrc_xml.py are in docs/research/fx/tremolo/evidence/tools/), then python3 gr6eq.py in $RE_STATE/work/eq/gr6bb

# EQ Parametric, band 1: peak gain, peak frequency, half-gain Q (search limited to f < 0.42 fs). Expected from the code (no pre-warp): f_peak = (fi/pi) atan(pi f / fi), f = 8.176*2^((119.589 v + 15.487)/12)

# fi = internal rate. At 44.1 and 48 kHz the plugin reports 16 samples of latency and rolls off above 0.45 fs (it runs the rack at twice the host rate); at 96 kHz it reports 0: fi = 2 fs below 50 kHz, else fs.
# EQ Graphic: defaults (Min Freq 0.5, Max Freq 0.5, Gain Range 0.5); one band at maximum: peak; then all eight at maximum: min..max between the outer centres
